title: 11.2 — Guardrails: The Runtime Safety Net
summary: In this chapter, guardrail means a runtime product control rather than a change to the model's trained weights. A product may inspect a request, supplied data, a proposed tool action or a generated draft, then allow, refuse, limit, redact or escalate it. Not every product uses every check, and a check can miss a problem or block a legitimate request.…
